description: Says whether an IPv4 or IPv6 address is in Cloudflare's published edge ranges, and which range. Returns { ip, version, cloudflare, range, rangesAsOf }: range is the matching CIDR or null. Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

ip.description: IPv4 (dotted quad) or IPv6 address, without a port or zone id.

name: cf-ip-check
title: Cloudflare IP check
